title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta23

## H1 location reliability

This beta aims to improve sparse H1/H1500 location updates and prevent old or
incomplete location reports from being displayed as fresh measurements when
the Navimow app is closed and Home Assistant is opened.

- Send an app-active report during normal cloud polling, at most once every
  five minutes while the integration is loaded. Failed reports wait until the
  next interval and do not make normal cloud polling fail. No Bluetooth
  connection is claimed. Reporting stops with integration polling on unload.
- Request precise location data with cloud location reads.
- Accept MQTT coordinates as a complete, finite pose. Partial reports, invalid
  values and future-dated poses cannot overwrite part of a previous position.
- Choose current cloud coordinates ahead of last-known coordinates regardless
  of response field order. Never combine axes from separate records or attach
  a current report timestamp to last-known coordinates.
- Separate MQTT message receipt, valid pose receipt and measurement age in
  diagnostics. A delayed or repeated old measurement cannot become fresh merely
  because its message just arrived. Missing measurement timestamps remain
  unknown rather than being replaced by the Home Assistant clock.
- Keep last-known cloud positions display-only and stale. Existing startup,
  departure and gate confirmation guards remain in place. An old pose cannot
  mark the live-position stream as recovered.

The app-active report and precise-location request are a beta attempt to help
H1 telemetry. Their effect on H1500 update frequency has **not yet been confirmed
on a physical mower**. This release does not promise continuous live tracking.

Restart Home Assistant after installing. No Map Card update is required.
For field validation, compare a similar mowing period with the Navimow app
closed and open, then check the downloaded diagnostics: app-presence outcomes,
message age, pose receipt age and measurement age. Also check the first dashboard
open after an HA restart, leaving the dock, and return to the dock. Old or
unknown-age positions should not be treated as fresh gate-position evidence.

### Validation

Offline regressions cover complete and partial poses, non-finite/sentinel
coordinates, zero axes, source ordering, future timestamps, missing measurement
time, current versus last-known coordinates, receipt versus measurement age,
bounded app-active retries and stopping reports on unload. Live cloud acceptance
of the new report and H1 telemetry improvement remain field-validation items.
